title: Natterer See Ferienparadies
highlights: Idyllic forest lake on the sunny high plateau west of Innsbruck
Massive aquapark featuring water trampolines, waterslides, and icebergs
Kayak, canoe, and stand-up paddleboard rentals directly by the lake
Comprehensive leisure program and top-class lakeside restaurant
kurzbeschreibung: Natterer See near Innsbruck combines a picturesque moor lake with an action-packed water adventure park.
beschreibung:
Bathing Lake and Water Adventures in Alpine Scenery

The Natterer See lies at 835 meters above sea level nestled in dense mixed forests near the village of Natters. The moor lake boasts outstanding water quality and pleasant summer temperatures, offering dreamlike views of the Kalkkögel and the Nordkette.

Attractions for Families and Sports Enthusiasts

The lakeside grounds thrill visitors with one of the largest inflatable aquaparks in the Alps, a 66-meter giant water slide, boat rentals, and sports fields. The lakeside restaurant with its covered terrace serves Tyrolean and international specialties with direct views over the sparkling water.
